title: Library tiles look like the mock's cards, with the name and length under the picture
goal: The Library shelf's tiles are now the mock's size, but they still look like the old ones: a picture with a centred grey name under it and the length stamped on the picture. The video mock draws each tile as a bordered card, picture edge to edge on top, the name left aligned in brighter type and its length (or "component") on a second quiet line under it.
notes: Found side by side in queue/audits/2026-09-27-library-tiles-mock.png vs 2026-09-27-library-tiles-media-sc.png. Mock CSS (docs/design/mocks/shared/dist/photonz-ds.css ~3619): .libtile border 1px edge-lo, radius r3, background glass-thin, overflow hidden; .th edge to edge aspect 16/10; .cap padding 5px 7px 6px, gap 1; .nm 10.5px weight 560 ink, left, ellipsis; .mt 9px mono faint. Measured in the mock at a 256 dock: tile 112x105, picture 110x69. App today (after library-tiles-are-as-wide-as-the-mock-draws-them): tile 114x90, picture 106x66 inset 4pt, name centred 10pt secondary, length as a corner badge in the picture. Tile views: LibraryPanel.swift LibraryTile, LibraryClipTile.swift, ComponentPanel.swift LibraryComponentTile, ColorStylePanel/TextStylePanel/EffectStylePanel tiles; they read LibraryTileMetrics from the environment. A second caption line changes tileHeight(width:sizing:) in LibraryShelfLayout.Sizing.card: add it there (measure the line) so the grid arithmetic stays exact. Keep Current on .compact. | DONE 2026-09-27: LibraryShelfTile (Sources/Photonz/LibraryShelfTile.swift) is the one view; its card mode is VideoKit.Tile. Meta per kind: clip length, picture pixel size (LibraryTileCaption.pictureSize), component entry.detail, styles paint/type/effect. Corner words: component version stays; origin tag and clip length only on compact. LibraryTileMetrics gained wellWidth + isCard. LibraryShelfLayout.defaultCap(sizing:) gives Next a 256pt first ceiling (Current 220) via LibraryPanel.init.
acceptance: Every Library tile at Next defaults is a bordered, rounded card with its picture edge to edge across the top, like video.html's Library
The name sits left aligned under the picture in the mock's brighter, slightly heavier type, and a recording's or sound's length sits on a quiet mono line under the name instead of on the picture
Components and Styles tiles use the same card, with a short second line where the mock gives one
The shelf height, reveal and squeeze floor still match what is drawn (LibraryShelfLayout tests and the shelf walks pass)
A picture of the shelf sits beside video.html's Library in the audit, differences listed
The card is one view that every Library shelf (Media, Comps, Styles) draws, not five tiles restyled to match

log.note: triage 2026-09-27: the tile is drawn by five separate views today (LibraryTile, LibraryClipTile, LibraryComponentTile and the colour, text and effect style tiles). Build the card once and have every shelf use it, rather than restyling five tiles to match.

Adversarial pass before building: VideoKit.Tile already IS the mock's .libtile (transition picker, caption styles), so the Library draws through it rather than a sixth tile. Risk found: a card row is 108pt, so the 220pt default shelf ceiling cut the second row through its meta line; fixed with a Next-only first ceiling of two rows + peek (256). Premiere/FCP icon view puts name + duration under the thumbnail, so the meta line is where an editor looks.

Built: LibraryShelfTile (Sources/Photonz/LibraryShelfTile.swift) is the one tile every shelf draws; card mode = VideoKit.Tile, compact mode = Current's old tile. Six tile views (picture, clip, component, colour/text/effect style) hand it a picture, name and meta. Card arithmetic in LibraryShelfLayout (cardBorder, cardCaption*, pictureWidth, defaultCap), meta wording in LibraryTileCaption, both tested. library-shelf-height-walk now drags the grab bar with dragHandle (the old fixed-coordinate drags hit nothing once the ceiling moved) and checks 256->189->306.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 10109 tests green; 18 walks ok at Next defaults (starter-shelf, library-shelf-height, shelf-tile-reveal, library-import, library, library-clip-onto-a-track, shelf-scope-switch, shelf-origin, library-reveal, library-drag, tutorial-the-library, effect-style, colour-off-the-shelf, tile-comes-away, colour-onto-the-library, document-media, text-style-drag, style-users), real captures under an unlocked screen. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-27-library-cards.json with side by side vs video.html Library. Hover lift is VideoKit.Tile's own and was not driven by a walk.

left rough (audit rough list, none clears the bar for a new task): tail ellipsis on long names follows the mock's CSS (asked in audit evaluate instead of filed); card 108 vs mock 105 from SwiftUI line heights; sound card keeps its waveform glyph; dock panel colour is the panel's, not the tile's; compact fallback (only with the cards flag off) now fills the effect tile's well with paper edge to edge.

Every Library tile in Next is the mock's bordered card (one LibraryShelfTile view on VideoKit.Tile, drawn by Media, Comps and Styles), name left in bright type and a mono meta line (length, pixel size, starter/copies, paint/type/effect). Card arithmetic + 256pt first ceiling in LibraryShelfLayout, tested; 10109 tests green; 18 shelf walks ok at Next defaults; audit 2026-09-27-library-cards.json with side by side vs video.html.
